newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets C&W/Bell Canada/Nynex cable TV deal.
newsitem.headline: EU vets C&W/Bell Canada/Nynex cable TV deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was starting a preliminary probe into a proposal by Bell Canada International Inc, Cable and Wireless Plc and Nynex Corporation to share control in C&W's cable television unit.
It said the deal was submitted for clearance on November 13 under the European Union's merger rules.
It has about a month from that date to clear the operation or start a four-month in-depth probe.

The Commission is also vetting another deal in C&W, BCE Inc are looking to acquire joint control of Bell Cablemedia Plc and Videotron Holdings Plc. These last two companies are also active in telecoms and cable TV.
